title: 第二十一章 悬空行针第二十二章 赵雅的病因
lines: 这个腿伤虽然正常走路没问题，却让她修炼备受煎熬，如同跗骨之毒，?34??年来，几乎没有一天欢笑。
正因为如此，才让她变成了现在对生人有些畏惧，不愿说话的性格。
本以为，这辈子都没办法治好了，没想到这位人人都觉得是废物的张悬老师，直接开口说“小事！”，让她难以相信自己的耳朵。
如果换做之前，肯定觉得是吹牛，但对方一口说出了受伤的原因，让她内心忍不住生出期盼。
“让你单独来房间，自然是为你治疗的！好了，全身放松！”
张悬从房间取出一个不大的玉盒，轻轻打开，里面摆满了长短不一的银针。
武者修炼，受伤是常有的事，因此，学院在每个教室都配备了这东西，能够帮人疏通血脉，暂时缓解伤势。
“是！”看到少年语气沉着稳重，自信而不张扬，王颖不知为何，内心深处不由自主的相信起来，紧接着全身放松下来。
嗖！
张悬坐在原地并未动弹，拿起一根银针，笔直弹了过去。
一声轻鸣，蕴含他一道真气的银针，就笔直向王颖飞了过去，扎在腿上。
“这是……悬空行针？”王颖眼睛瞪大，娇躯再次颤抖。
悬空行针，是不接触患者身体，利用武者对力量的精纯掌控力，控制银针飞行，准确刺**位！
这样做，男医者不用接触女患者，就可以行针，能避免不少不必要的尴尬。
这种行针，说起来简单，实际上十分复杂，首先要求武者对力量绝对掌控，稍有偏差，就可能导致失败！其次，对眼力也要有很大的要求，隔着衣服，并不容易认穴，一旦认错，就会出现各种麻烦！
原语大师曾说过，想要虚空行针，修为至少要达到武者五重鼎力境方能做到！
难道这个学院被称为废物的老师，已经达到这种境界了？
这不可能啊！
达到鼎力境的的，每一个都赫赫有名，像陆寻一样的名师，根据刘老所说，这个张悬老师，不过武者三重真气境，距离五重鼎力境，还有很大一段距离！
武者三重真气境，就能施展悬空行针？
她不敢相信！
嗖嗖嗖嗖！
正觉得难以置信，少年又弹出几枚银针。
一连串风声，银针落在她的腿上，刚好相同深浅，足见对方对力量的控制已然达到炉火纯青的地步。
银针落在腿上，王颖正想对方如何治疗，就见少年手掌一划，银针上蕴含的真气同时触动，钻**道。
真气进入体内，一阵酸麻，之前被封堵的穴道，立刻冲开。
“这……这……这是上三品的真气纯度？”
全身一阵酸麻，王颖“看”清了进入体内真气的模样！
清澈如水，没有丝毫杂质。
竟然是……上三品真气才有的品质！
上三品真气？
这可是神、圣级功法才能修炼出来的，整个天玄王国，从未听说谁能修炼的出来，这位最废物的老师，居然有？我不会看错了吧……
“好了！”
正在震撼，紧接着全身一松，银针已经被对方收走。
紧接着王颖就感到，双腿一阵轻松，前所未有的舒服。
content_en:
Although she had no problem walking normally due to this leg injury, it made her practice torment, like a tarsal poison. For 34 years, she hardly laughed a day.
Because of this, she has become a bit afraid of strangers and unwilling to speak.
She thought that there would be no cure in her life, but she didn't expect that Teacher Zhang Xuan, whom everyone thought was a waste, directly said "It's a trivial matter!" She couldn't believe her ears.
If she had done it before, she would have thought it was bragging, but the other person told her the reason for the injury, and she couldn't help but feel hopeful in her heart.
"Let you come to the room alone, so I will naturally treat you! Now, relax your whole body!"
Zhang Xuan took out a small jade box from the room and opened it gently. It was filled with silver needles of different lengths.
It is common for warriors to get injured while practicing. Therefore, the academy is equipped with this device in every classroom, which can help people dredge their blood vessels and temporarily relieve their injuries.
"Yes!" Seeing the young man's calm, steady, confident and unassuming tone, Wang Ying couldn't help but believe it deep down in her heart for some reason, and then her whole body relaxed.
Whoosh!
Zhang Xuan sat on the spot without moving, picked up a silver needle and flicked it straight over.
With a soft cry, the silver needle containing his true energy flew straight towards Wang Ying and pierced his leg.
"Is this... acupuncture in the air?" Wang Ying's eyes widened and her delicate body trembled again.
Acupuncture in the air does not come into contact with the patient's body. The martial artist's pure control of power is used to control the flight of the silver needle and accurately puncture the target!
In this way, the male doctor can perform acupuncture without touching the female patient, which can avoid a lot of unnecessary embarrassment.
This kind of acupuncture sounds simple, but is actually very complicated. First of all, it requires the warrior to have absolute control over the power. A slight deviation may lead to failure! Secondly, it also requires a lot of eyesight. It is not easy to identify the acupuncture points through clothes. Once you make a mistake, all kinds of troubles will occur!
Master Yuan Yu once said that if you want to move needles in the void, your cultivation level must at least reach the fifth level of the warrior realm!
Could it be that the teacher in this college, who is called a waste, has reached this level?
This is impossible!
Those who have reached the Dali realm are all famous, famous teachers like Lu Xun. According to Mr. Liu, this teacher Zhang Xuan is only a warrior at the third level of true energy realm, and there is still a long way to go before the fifth level of Dali realm!
A warrior with the third level of true energy can perform the suspended needle?
She couldn't believe it!
Swish swish swish!
Just when he felt unbelievable, the boy popped out a few more silver needles.
There was a series of wind sounds, and the silver needle fell on her leg, just the same depth, which showed that the other party's control of power had reached the level of perfection.
The silver needle fell on her leg. Wang Ying was just thinking about how to treat the other party, when she saw the young man's palm swiping, and the zhenqi contained in the silver needle was touched at the same time, and he said secretly.
"Ah..."
As the true energy entered the body, there was a burst of soreness and numbness, and the previously blocked acupuncture points immediately opened.
"This...this...is this the purity of the third-grade infuriating energy?"
Her whole body felt sore and numb, and Wang Ying "saw" clearly the appearance of the true energy entering her body!
It is as clear as water without any impurities.
It turned out to be...a quality only possessed by upper-level third-grade infuriating energy!
A third-grade infuriating spirit?
This is a skill that can only be cultivated by gods and saints. In the entire Tianxuan Kingdom, I have never heard of anyone who can cultivate it. This most useless teacher actually has it? I can't be wrong...
"Okay!"
He was shocked, and then his whole body relaxed, and the silver needle had been taken away by the other party.
Immediately afterwards, Wang Ying felt that her legs relaxed and felt unprecedentedly comfortable.
